manifest.name: dsh-infinite-context
manifest.description: DSH 上下文治理插件：分层记忆、可逆压缩、按会话阶段规划的水位控制。/ Context governance for DeepSeek Harness: layered memory, reversible compaction and phase-aware water levels.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && vitest run && npm run build

bundle.text:
# dsh-infinite-context bundle patch layer
# Applied when installed via: dsh plugin --profile web add .

# Disable the built-in compaction-basic (replaced by memory-compaction).
- id: compaction-basic
  disabled: true

# Insert the three plugin entries.
- insert:
    # 1) Persistent multi-tier memory store + embedder + index + budget.
    # Bare subpath specifiers resolve through node_modules against the
    # installed package's exports map. RELATIVE paths resolve against the
    # PROFILE directory and break bundle installs (verified 2026-08-30).
    - id: memory-context
      name: dsh-infinite-context/memory-context
      config:
        # Relative resolves below <DSH_HOME>/storages (NOT the process cwd, which
        # is just wherever `dsh` was launched). Absolute paths and `~` also work.
        storePath: dsh-infinite-context.db
        contextWindow: 94000
        headroomRatio: 0.25
        # Live model-context probing for LOCAL servers (e.g. qwen3.8-27b at
        # 127.0.0.1:1234). DSH's catalog may declare a much larger window than
        # the server actually runs; the probe reads the REAL runtime context
        # (llama.cpp meta.n_ctx / LM Studio /api/v0/models) and the plugin caps
        # at min(declared, probed) so compression triggers before the real limit
        # overflows.
        # baseURL is LEFT EMPTY so the probe targets whatever LOCAL server the
        # session routes to (resolved from the provider's llm-pi-ai baseURL) —
        # zero per-deployment config.
        # Locality gate: only models whose provider baseURL points at a
        # loopback / private-LAN host are probed. Online providers (glm / mimo /
        # ark ...) are NEVER probed — they are trusted at the window declared in
        # settings.yaml (or pinned via modelWindows below).
        modelProbe:
          enabled: true
          kind: openai
          baseURL: ''
        # Explicit per-model context windows (authoritative per-model truth).
        # These feed the per-model registry that the dynamic compaction
        # threshold and per-session budgets read; a successful live probe can
        # still narrow them further. LOCAL qwen3 models are NOT listed here on
        # purpose — their real window comes from the live probe (llama.cpp
        # n_ctx) and a stale pin would block the probe from raising it (the
        # probe only ever narrows). Adjust/remove to match the models you run:
        #   - glm-5.3-flash / mimo-v2.5-pro: online models declared in
        #     settings.yaml (1M). Listed here so the dynamic threshold knows
        #     the real window even if a deployment omits the settings entry.
        #   - ark deepseek-v4-*: NOT pinned — their window is left to the
        #     deployment's settings.yaml (DSH default 262144) because an
        #     unverified pin would shrink a live session's budget and truncate
        #     it (2026-09-03 incident).
        modelWindows:
          - model: glm-5.3-flash
            contextWindow: 1000000
          - model: mimo-v2.5-pro
            contextWindow: 1000000
        embedder:
          kind: lightweight
          dimension: 256
        budget:
          short: 10000
          mid: 20000
          long: 5000
          retrieved: 15000
        forgetting:
          halfLifeDays: 30
          importanceWeight: 0.6
          recencyWeight: 0.4
          minScore: 0.25
          maxMemories: 500
        pyramid:
          mergeThreshold: 4
          mergeBatch: 3
          maxLong: 20
        retrievalMinScore: 0.2
        retrievalTopK: 5

    # 2) Compaction engine with progressive compression + RAG injection.
    - id: memory-compaction
      name: dsh-infinite-context/memory-compaction
      config:
        auto: true
        # Compaction trigger ratio: lowered from 0.8 to 0.7 so LOCAL models
        # compact earlier — long-context local inference TPS collapses well
        # before the window is full, so compacting at ~70% of the real window
        # (qwen3 167936 → ~117K) keeps the model in its fast zone. The dynamic
        # floor below still pulls the trigger earlier as the window fills.
        thresholdRatio: 0.7
        # Recent-tail retention: 0.3 keeps ~30% of the window verbatim and
        # compacts the older head more aggressively than 0.4 (verified 2026-09-04
        # on local qwen3: 137K-token session compacted to ~95K at 0.4; 0.3 would
        # compact to ~60K). Compensate with a higher summarizer cap below so the
        # bigger shadowed span still yields a detail-preserving summary.
        retainRatio: 0.3
        # Summarization target is deliberately EMPTY: the compaction backend
        # (compaction-basic) and this plugin resolve the provider/model from the
        # SESSION's routed model (`configured ?? latest`), so a local-model
        # session summarizes with the local model and a cloud session with the
        # cloud model — no per-profile patch needed. Pinning a hard-coded
        # provider here (e.g. deepseek-official) overrides the session route and
        # silently breaks every compaction when that endpoint is down or the
        # account is out of balance (Insufficient Balance). Set BOTH keys to a
        # concrete pair only to force a specific summarization model.
        summarizationProvider: ''
        summarizationModel: ''
        # Summarizer output cap: raised from 8192 to 10000 so the larger
        # shadowed span (retainRatio 0.3) still fits a complete, detail-rich
        # checkpoint instead of being cut off at the token cap.
        maxTokens: 10000
        compactionRetries: 1
        maxOverflowRetries: 1
        retrieval:
          enabled: true
          topK: 3
          minScore: 0.2
        compress_round_interval: 7
        # History-compression trigger: lowered from 0.85 to 0.75 so the
        # plugin's own per-step history compression also fires earlier — again
        # keeping short-context local models out of the slow long-context zone.
        compress_trigger_ratio: 0.75
        compress_target_ratio: 0.6
        # Dynamic water levels: inside hard safety bounds, slide the trigger DOWN
        # and the target DEEPER as the session heats up (growth EMA) or matures
        # (prior compressions). Trigger <= 0.92 / >= 0.65; target >= 0.25;
        # band 0.08..0.45. Set false to disable steering; hard bounds still apply.
        compress_dynamic_levels: true
        # Unified governor: one policy decides lane + water levels; the fold
        # executor obeys it. Off = legacy per-lane triggers.
        compaction_governance: true        # Track the routed model's REAL context window (probe / modelWindows):
        # when it is smaller than the declared window, force durable-history
        # compaction at a threshold derived from the REAL window instead of
        # waiting for a declared-window threshold the model can never reach.
        # This is what makes short-context local models "refill" (续杯) in time,
        # including after one very long thinking turn.
        compaction_dynamic_threshold: true
        # Dynamic trigger ratio floor: as the REAL window fills past ~50%, the
        # effective trigger ratio slides from thresholdRatio (0.7) toward this
        # floor (0.5), so compaction fires around ~60% of the window — early
        # enough for slow local models to stay in their fast zone while leaving
        # enough remaining context to run the summarization pass itself.
        compaction_dynamic_floor: 0.5
        # Mid-thinking context guard: wraps the agent's LLM stream and, when
        # input + output-so-far approaches the CURRENT model's real window,
        # injects a CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED finish so the engine compacts
        # durably and the request retries with room — the plugin intervenes
        # even while the model is deep-thinking, and a takeover whose input is
        # already over the line is compacted BEFORE any generation. The trigger
        # line is DYNAMIC: window − (system/tools + estimated summary + margin),
        # so the model's REMAINING context is always enough to run the plugin's
        # own compaction. ratio is the CEILING (0.9 default).
        thinking_guard_enabled: true
        thinking_guard_ratio: 0.9
        retain_recent_messages: 4
        sanitize_max_chars: 2000
        rag_top_k: 3
        rag_min_score: 0.3
        rag_token_budget: 3000
        rag_chunk_size: 500
        rag_dedupe_exact: true
        rag_dedupe_min_score: 0.92
        # Surface-aware retrieval de-dup: a memory whose text is ALREADY on the
        # active context (typically a tool result ingested a few steps ago but
        # not yet compressed away) is not re-injected — it would spend tokens on
        # text the model can already read. Suppression is state-dependent, never
        # permanent: once compaction removes the text from the surface, the
        # memory becomes eligible again.
        rag_surface_dedupe: true
        # Local-model conciseness mode: when the session is routed to a LOCAL
        # (loopback / private-LAN baseURL) provider, inject one short runtime
        # directive that forbids inter-tool narration, requires independent
        # calls to be batched in one step, and pushes all explanation into the
        # final answer. Narration written by a local model is re-sent as input
        # on every later request (and re-paid after each cache expiry), so the
        # directive pays for itself within a turn. Injected at most once per
        # surface (re-injected only after compaction drops the previous copy).
        concise_local_mode: true
        # Tool-result archive (CCR): a tool result larger than the threshold is
        # stored verbatim under a content-addressed ref (tr_<sha256[0..12)>) and
        # the surface node becomes a head+ref+tail stub, so the built-in
        # tool-result-pruner (which drops the middle beyond recovery, and only
        # when a compaction fires) never has to destroy anything: memory_expand
        # can hand the full text back. The threshold sits below the pruner's
        # 8192 so our stub wins. Rewrites only touch nodes appended since the
        # previous pass (a rebuilt prefix is a provider cache miss); the one
        # exception is compaction, which rebuilds the prefix anyway.
        tool_archive: true
        tool_archive_threshold_chars: 6000
        tool_archive_head_chars: 2048
        tool_archive_tail_chars: 1024
        tool_archive_max_entries: 500
        tool_archive_retention_days: 30
        # Immediate distillation: an oversized result is reduced to signal lines
        # (errors/counts/diff stats/paths + head/tail) and that digest IS the stub.
        # min_chars sits below the archive threshold on purpose: a result can be too
        # small to archive and still worth distilling. The digest is also ingested as
        # a memory, so "what error did that command report" survives compaction.
        tool_absorb: true
        tool_absorb_min_chars: 4000
        tool_absorb_max_digest_chars: 1200
        # Predictive compression: a surface-growth EMA fires the compression one step
        # early when the NEXT request would cross the trigger anyway.
        compress_nudge: true
        # Context accounting: injections/skips/archive/absorb/nudge/savings plus the
        # provider's disjoint input/output/cacheRead/cacheWrite, summarised in
        # memory_status. Never pre-summed (that would erase the cache hit rate).
        usage_ledger: true
        usage_retention_days: 30
        # Reverse compaction: before a compression folds a range into a summary,
        # the exact messages are archived (folded_ranges) so memory_expand can
        # read them back — the engine-layer equivalent of upstream decompress.
        fold_ranges: true
        fold_range_retention_days: 30
        fold_range_max_entries: 300
        rag_ingest_importance: 0.3
        rag_ingest_denylist:
          - memory_search
          - memory_status
          - memory_index
          - memory_maintain
          - memory_model_probe
          - memory_forget
          - memory_consolidate
          - memory_reset
          - memory_ingest
          - memory_force_compress
          - memory_expand
          - todo_write
          - ask_user_question
          - interrupt_agent
          - job_list
          - job_output
          - job_kill
          - list_agents
          - send_message
          - subagent
          - subagent_fork
          - workflow
          - ralph
          - skill

    # 3) Manual tools (memory_search, memory_status, etc.).
    - id: memory-tools
      name: dsh-infinite-context/tools

readme.text: DeepSeek Harness 的上下文管家插件。它让 AI 助手在超长对话中不"失忆"、不"爆窗"：旧对话自动整理成摘要并存档，重要的事情每轮主动提醒，需要细节时随时找回原文。

[跳到英文说明](#english)

---

和 AI 助手长期协作时，你会遇到两个问题：

1. **窗口装不下** —— 对话太长，超出模型一次能读取的上限，请求直接报错。
2. **压缩即失忆** —— 普通的压缩会把旧对话直接丢掉：做过什么决定、试过什么方案、有什么约束，全都没了。

本插件的思路是**压缩不等于删除**：旧对话被折叠成一份结构化摘要，原文完整存档、随时可取回；同时把"当前任务进行到哪了"主动放在模型眼前，不靠它自己想起来去查。

**1. 智能折叠：像整理会议纪要**

对话接近上限时，较早的内容自动折叠成一份结构化摘要——总目标、关键决定、改过的文件、遇到的问题、待办事项，一目了然。

折叠的时机和深度不是死规则：

- 看阶段：模型正在连续调用工具时推迟，一段话说完的间隙才动手；
- 看内容：大量工具输出适合折深一些，重要指令则尽量保留原文；
- 会自我修正：每次折叠记录"实际结果与计划的偏差"，下次自动补偿；
- 有安全底线：模型正在思考或回答时**绝不**动手，两次折叠之间有最小间隔，避免反复折腾。

**2. 一切可恢复**

折叠前，原文完整存档，摘要开头给出一个取回编号（如 `fl_ab12cd34ef56`）。模型或你随时可以用 `memory_expand` 工具读回原文，支持分页和关键词定位；读不完会明确告知总长度和下一次怎么取。

超长的工具输出（一次大文件读取、一份长日志）同样先存档，再用一个带编号的短摘要占位——需要细节时一键展开。

**3. 记忆金字塔**

每次折叠的摘要存入本地数据库（重启不丢）。积攒多了，插件会自动把**主题相近**的几条合并成更高层的"长期记忆"；新对话或新问题时，最相关的历史记忆自动检索并注入给模型。

**4. 任务状态提醒（工作记忆）**

每次折叠后，插件从摘要中提取"总目标 / 待办 / 下一步 / 关键约束"，之后**每一轮**都主动放在模型眼前。

这解决一个真实痛点：记忆检索靠"相似度"，而五十轮之前的待办和当前问题往往并不相似——靠模型自己想起来去查，生产环境中一次也没发生过。主动提醒才是可靠的。

**5. 提前准备，而不是让你等**

快到折叠点时，插件会在后台提前把摘要写好；真正需要折叠时直接取用，现场零等待。如果后台准备会和你的对话抢同一个模型服务器的位置（本地小窗口部署时可能发生），它会自动让路——对话永远优先。

**6. 会自己学习的参数**

- 每个模型路线"摘要实际需要多久"，由插件持续测量并自动调整等待时间——本地部署的大模型慢但健康，等待会自动放宽；云端卡死的流不会浪费第二次机会。
- 每次折叠"实际落点与计划的偏差"持续记录，下一次自动补偿。
- 提供商报"装不下"时，记下服务器的真实容量，之后按真实容量规划，而不是按声明值硬撑。
- 你在配置里手工指定的值优先级最高，学习只在未指定时生效。

**7. 其他能力**

- 工具结果即时提炼：大段输出先提取关键行（错误、计数、文件路径），原文存档备用。
- 本地部署优化：自动识别 127.0.0.1 / 局域网上的模型，按探测到的真实窗口规划、注入精简指令、放宽等待。
- 中英文双语场景：摘要格式与关键信息提取都覆盖中文的错误、警告与超时行。

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `memory_search` | 搜索全部历史记忆 |
| `memory_expand` | 展开被折叠/存档的原文（支持分页、关键词） |
| `memory_status` | 查看记忆系统状态与用量统计 |
| `memory_index` | 浏览记忆索引 |
| `memory_maintain` | 记忆库体检：重复、冲突、低价值条目 |

所有配置在 `cordis.yml`，每一项都有注释。最常用的：

| 配置 | 作用 | 默认 |
|---|---|---|
| `compaction_governance` | 统一折叠调度（建议保持开启） | `true` |
| `summarization_timeout_ms` | 单次摘要的等待上限（毫秒）；`0` = 不限制 | 自动：本地 240s / 云端 90s，随输入伸缩，并随实测学习 |
| `task_state_enabled` | 每轮注入任务状态提醒 | `true` |
| `speculative_fold` | 后台提前准备折叠摘要 | `true` |
| `tool_archive` | 超长工具结果存档 | `true` |
| `rag_top_k` 等检索项 | 每轮注入多少条相关记忆 | 见 `cordis.yml` |

完整清单与每项的详细说明见 `cordis.yml` 内注释。

需要 Node.js ≥ 22.19.0 和 DSH 0.2.x。

```sh
npm pack
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-infinite-context-<version>.tgz
```

安装后**重启 DSH** 生效。数据（记忆、存档、统计）存放在 DSH 数据目录的 `storages` 下，升级插件不会丢失。

- 折叠通过 DSH 自带的 `compaction-basic` 完成，工具调用与结果的配对永远完整。
- 本地模型（127.0.0.1 / 内网地址）自动识别：按探测到的真实窗口规划、放宽摘要等待、注入精简指令。
- 默认的语义向量化是内置实现，零第三方依赖；需要更强的语义检索可自行安装 `@huggingface/transformers`。
- 本地模型只支持特定推理档位时，摘要调用沿用会话当前的档位设置。

---

Long-running sessions with an AI assistant hit two walls:

1. **The window fills up** — the conversation outgrows what the model can read at once and requests start failing.
2. **Compaction means amnesia** — naive compaction throws old context away: decisions made, approaches tried, constraints stated — all gone.

This plugin's principle: **compaction is not deletion**. Old turns are folded into a structured summary while the original text is archived and retrievable on demand; and the current task state is actively placed in front of the model every turn instead of relying on it to remember.

**1. Smart folding, like meeting minutes**

As the conversation nears its limit, older turns fold into a structured summary — goals, decisions, files changed, problems hit, pending work.

When and how deep to fold is not a fixed rule:

Before folding, the original text is archived and the summary carries a reference (e.g. `fl_ab12cd34ef56`). The model — or you — can read the exact original back via the `memory_expand` tool, with paging and keyword search; truncated reads state the full length and the exact next call.

Oversized tool outputs (a big file read, a long log) are archived the same way and replaced by a short stub that carries the reference.

**3. The memory pyramid**

Every fold summary is persisted locally (survives restarts). As they accumulate, topically-similar summaries are consolidated into higher-level long-term memories; the most relevant ones are retrieved and injected for new questions automatically.

**4. Task-state reminders (working memory)**

After each fold the plugin extracts "goal / pending / next step / key constraints" from the summary and places it in front of the model **every single turn**.

This fixes a real gap: memory retrieval works by similarity, and a fifty-turn-old pending job is rarely similar to the current question — in production the model never once searched on its own. Pushing beats hoping.

**5. Prepared in advance, instead of making you wait**

As the surface approaches the fold trigger, the summary is precomputed in the BACKGROUND; the actual fold consumes it with zero waiting. If the background call would contend with your conversation for the same local server (possible on small local deployments), it stands down — the conversation always wins.

**6. Parameters that learn**

- How long a summary takes per model route is measured continuously and the wait adjusts itself — a big locally-deployed model is slow but alive, so waits widen; a dead cloud stream does not get a second patient chance.
- How far each fold actually landed from its plan is tracked and compensated.
- When a provider rejects a request for size, the server's real capacity is recorded and future folds plan against reality, not the declared number.
- Values you set explicitly always win; learning only applies where you did not.

**7. Also included**

- Immediate distillation of tool results: signal lines (errors, counts, paths) extracted, full text archived.
- Local-deployment optimizations: automatic discovery of 127.0.0.1 / LAN models, planning against probed real windows, concise-mode directives.
- Bilingual (Chinese/English) summaries and signal extraction, including Chinese error and warning lines.

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `memory_search` | Search all stored memories |
| `memory_expand` | Expand folded/archived original text (paging, keyword) |
| `memory_status` | Memory system status and usage statistics |
| `memory_index` | Browse the memory index |
| `memory_maintain` | Health check: duplicates, conflicts, stale entries |

| Key | Purpose | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `compaction_governance` | Unified fold scheduling (keep on) | `true` |
| `summarization_timeout_ms` | Per-attempt summary deadline (ms); `0` = unlimited | auto: local 240s / cloud 90s, scaled by input, refined by learning |
| `task_state_enabled` | Per-turn task-state reminder | `true` |
| `speculative_fold` | Background precomputation of fold summaries | `true` |
| `tool_archive` | Archive oversized tool results | `true` |
| `rag_top_k` etc. | How many memories to inject per turn | see `cordis.yml` |
The full list with per-key explanations is in the comments of `cordis.yml`.

Requires Node.js ≥ 22.19.0 and DSH 0.2.x.

```sh
npm pack
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-infinite-context-<version>.tgz
```

**Restart DSH** after installing. Data (memories, archives, statistics) lives under the DSH data directory's `storages` folder and survives upgrades.

- Folding runs through DSH's built-in `compaction-basic`; tool call/result pairing is always preserved.
- Local models (127.0.0.1 / private LAN) are detected automatically: planning against probed real windows, wider summary deadlines, concise-mode directives.
- The default embedder is built in with zero third-party dependencies; install `@huggingface/transformers` yourself for stronger semantic retrieval.
- When a local model only accepts specific reasoning levels, summary calls follow the session's current setting.
